description: This file defines the CartViewModel class, which serves as a ViewModel for managing cart-related data and interactions within the UI of an Android shopping application. It maintains reactive streams of cart data, handles cart operations, and formats data for display. Additionally, it defines a sealed class for representing RecyclerView rows.

classes.name: CartViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that manages cart data streams, interactions, and state for the cart UI in an Android shopping app.

classes.name: CartRow
classes.description: A sealed class representing either a header (category) or an item row for a sectioned RecyclerView display of cart items.

methods.name: ensureCartLoaded
methods.description: Ensures that the backend cart data has been fetched at least once for the current user identity.

methods.name: setActiveEmail
methods.description: Sets or clears the email associated with the cart, affecting cart ownership.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart based on the product ID.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product in the cart; removes the item if the quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
